newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise seven bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise seven bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated November 15 to commercial banks worth seven billion Lebanese pounds compared with 15 billion last week.
The Bank sold 45-day CDs worth four billion pounds compared with 11 billion last week. It sold 60-day CDs worth three billion pounds compared with four billion last week.
Interest rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs were 12.25 percent and 13.00 percent, respectively.
